(KW Engineering) up to $103,770, including up to $9,430 for additional services, for commissioning services that check that building systems and controls work and communicate properly for the Roosevelt Middle School modernization. Work is scheduled from October 12, 2023 to September 13, 2028.

vendor.name: Kilowatt Engineering, Inc., dba KW Engineering

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement for Engineering Services – KW Engineering – Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $54,324 for KDI Group to inspect solar construction at four school sites
enrichment.summary: The district would pay KDI Group, Inc. up to $54,324, including up to $4,339 for additional services, to provide an Inspector of Record and administrative support that meet Division of the State Architect (DSA) requirements for the Solar Initiative Project at Horace Mann, Madison Park, Oakland Academy of Knowledge and Esperanza. Work is scheduled from October 12, 2023 to December 30, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement for Inspection of Record Services for Construction - KDI Group, Inc. - Solar Initiative Project -Various Sites: Horace Mann; Madison Park; Oakland Academy of Knowledge and Esperanza - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $1,220.74 to DecoTech's camera security upgrade at La Escuelita and Dewey Academy
enrichment.summary: This change order adds $1,220.74 to the DecoTech Systems security improvement contract, raising the not-to-exceed amount to $191,720.74. After reviewing existing cameras, DecoTech will replace patch cables and make networking changes to 19 cameras for consistency. All other contract terms stay the same.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – DecoTech Systems – La Escuellita Education Center and Dewey Academy Security Improvement - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Buys Pre-K classroom furniture for Laurel Child Development Center for up to $177,457.99
enrichment.summary: The district would pay Building Block Interiors, Inc., the lowest responsible bidder, up to $177,457.99 to provide, deliver and install Pre-K classroom furniture at the Laurel Child Development Center. The item also sets a contingency allowance of $14,696.31. Work is scheduled from October 12, 2023 to January 1, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Purchase Order Contract Agreement – Building Block Interiors, Inc. – Laurel Child Development Center Furniture Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
